description: Finds and reads the reminderfox.ics the original ReminderFox add-on kept in a Thunderbird or Firefox profile (read only: nothing else is read, nothing is written).

functions.name: find
functions.description: The reminderfox.ics files in this Thunderbird profile and the other Thunderbird, Firefox, SeaMonkey, Waterfox and Pale Moon profiles of this user, newest first: [{path, modified, size, current}].

functions.name: read
functions.description: One file that find() returned: {name, text, prefs} (prefs: the profile's prefs.js, for the add-on's list names, or '').
